sources: SumerSports WR/TE 2025 (routes, TPRR, YPRR, ADoT, catch %, EPA, target share) — sumersports.com, last updated 2026-09-02

meta.note: Breakout rank weights SumerSports usage by stickiness, then boosts youth, vacated volume, and late ADP. Already-priced WR1s (ADP ~top 12) are discounted on the breakout board — they still lead the usage board.

metrics.label: Target share
metrics.why: A target is worth ~1.8 PPR points on average. Highest raw correlation to scoring.

metrics.label: Air-yards share
metrics.why: Measures how valuable those targets are. Deep targets score more even when incomplete.

metrics.label: WOPR
metrics.why: 1.5 × target share + 0.7 × air-yards share. Built specifically to predict PPR. Elite WRs live at ~0.70+.

metrics.label: TPRR (first-read proxy)
metrics.why: Better predictor of next year’s points than raw target share. Tells you who the offense wants. SumerSports first-read share is not public; TPRR is the closest free analog.

metrics.label: Routes + TPRR
metrics.why: You can’t get targets if you’re not running routes. TPRR is how often they look his way.

metrics.label: 1D per route
metrics.why: Beats YPRR and TPRR at predicting next-year FPG. First downs = PPR + half-PPR value.

metrics.label: YPRR
metrics.why: Good efficiency snapshot. Weaker than volume for forecasting.

metrics.label: 20+ / air-yard targets
metrics.why: TD equity. Noisy week to week, real over a season.

metrics.label: TDs, YAC, catch rate, separation
metrics.why: Outputs or talent signals. Weak year-to-year, weak as standalone predictors.
